title: HERON HOP
oneLiner: Guide a brave frog across drifting lily pads while diving herons turn every landing into a split-second choice.
hook: Choose whether to make a short safe hop or a longer leap for faster progress: distant pads advance you more quickly but leave less time to dodge a swooping her，
ramp: The opening presents wide, stationary pads and one slow heron as a safe lesson. Later sections alternate calm stretches with pressure bursts, adding moving pads, narrower gaps, and herons with clearer
mechanics: The frog automatically faces right and can move horizontally while grounded or airborne; LEFT/RIGHT accelerate toward a capped 72 px/s drift.

A press of A starts a hop from a pad or while standing at the water edge. Each hop follows a fixed arc of about 32 px height and 0.64 seconds total; releasing A early shortens the ascent, while holding it gives the full arc.
Landing on the top surface of a lily pad is safe and immediately permits the next hop; landing near an edge slides the frog toward the water, creating a brief recovery window.
The camera scrolls right as the frog reaches the forward half of the screen. New pad arrangements are authored in short chunks with every required gap reachable by a full hop.

Herons enter from either side, pause briefly with a visible wing-fold telegraph, then swoop diagonally across a pad lane. A heron crossing the frog's body or a frog touching its beak causes a hit; each heron event can damage the frog only once.
After a hit, the frog flashes for 0.9 seconds and is knocked backward; falling into the water or taking a second hit loses a life and restarts at the last checkpoint pad.

Reach the riverbank goal after six scrolling sections to win. Each section contains a recovery stretch after its peak threat pattern, and difficulty caps at three simultaneous herons and 48 px/s heron swoop speed.
The first section teaches wide-pad landings, then adds alternating pad heights, moving pads, and synchronized heron dives one pattern at a time.
artDirection: 256x224 horizontal playfield with the frog as a readable 16x18 pixel sprite: bright green body, pale belly, red-orange throat, large eyes, and distinct crouched, airborne, landing, and flattened hurt poses. Lily pads are 26–38 pixels wide with dark green rims and vein highlights; herons are 28x22 pixels, white and blue-gray with a long pointed beak, folded idle wings, wide swoop wings, and an unmistakable red warning eye. Use a deep blue-green water background, two quiet parallax reed layers, and high-contrast silhouettes around active pads and herons. Keep the frog and threats brighter than the water; use small splash and feather effects for landings and hits.

controls.left: Steer the frog left during play and while airborne.
controls.right: Steer the frog right during play and while airborne.
controls.a: Hop when standing on a lily pad or during the brief landing recovery window.
controls.b: Hold B to brake horizontal drift while airborne or on a pad.

lose: Lose a life by falling into the water or being hit again after the frog's brief damage protection; lose all lives to end the run.
scoring: Score 100 for each new lily pad reached, 300 for passing beneath a swooping heron without being hit, and 1000 for reaching the riverbank; each event scores once.
